description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Trading Economics Economic Calendar data, including query parameters, data structures, validation, and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: TEEconomicCalendarQueryParams
classes.description: Extends EconomicCalendarQueryParams with additional validation and choices specific to Trading Economics.

classes.name: TEEconomicCalendarData
classes.description: Data model for Trading Economics Economic Calendar entries with field aliases and validation.

classes.name: TEEconomicCalendarFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to transform queries, retrieve, and process Trading Economics calendar data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a TEEconomicCalendarQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Trading Economics API based on query parameters and credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of TEEconomicCalendarData instances.
